Container.Name: i-was-here
Container.Overview: Design minimalist map posters of any place on earth and download them as print-ready PNG, JPEG or PDF files (up to 8K or 300 DPI). Pick a place, a palette and a typeface, add a title, done. Runs in your browser, no account, no tracking, works on phones and can be installed as an app.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port of the editor on your server, e.g. 9945 opens it at http://your-server:9945

Config.Name: Place search
Config.Description: photon (search as you type) or nominatim

Config.Name: Own geocoder URL
Config.Description: Optional: a self-hosted Photon or Nominatim, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:2322/api

Config.Name: Contact e-mail for Nominatim
Config.Description: Optional: sent to Nominatim as its usage policy asks

Config.Name: Map tiles (TileJSON URL)
Config.Description: Vector tiles in the OpenMapTiles schema. The default (OpenFreeMap) is free and needs no key.

Config.Name: Map fonts (glyphs URL)
Config.Description: Only used for the optional district names on the map
